constraints: Roster membership and listed first goalie never establish starting status.
Absent injury list is missingness, not healthy.
Published/effective/retrieved/reviewed timestamps must each precede forecast cutoff.
Post-start boxscores cannot reconstruct a pregame confirmation.
Official game ID must be source-bound; never equate ESPN and NHL IDs.
Changes create immutable successor snapshots and never rewrite frozen forecasts.
fit_and_promotion_dependency: Historical PIT-aligned coverage, registered dev/calibration/holdout split, paired ablation, leakage tests and approved model identity required before fitting a numerical personnel increment.
